• 1/2" (25mm) rearward**

• Handlebar width is increased by 1/2" to 25 3/4" inches overall

• Machined from a solid 6061 aluminum billet, the new TracStar is both lightweight and extremely strong

• This exceptional build quality is backed by a 30 day money back satisfaction guarantee
